# A2UI v1.0 schemas (vendored)

Copied unmodified from <https://github.com/google/A2UI> at commit `102ec1a04975` (2026-10-01), Apache-2.0
(see `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` and the upstream `LICENSE`). The upstream README still calls v1.0 "a candidate for
becoming stable", so the exporter is pinned to this commit.

| File | Upstream path |
|---|---|
| `agent_to_renderer.json` | `specification/v1_0/json/agent_to_renderer.json` |
| `common_types.json` | `specification/v1_0/json/common_types.json` |
| `catalog.json` | `catalogs/basic/v1/catalog.json` (the upstream test runner aliases it to `catalog.json` the same way) |

They are used only to validate exporter output in tests.
